text:
Carmen: Quick sync — need to lock owners for three items before we close the obs roadmap slice: dashboard error-rate view, trace hook for inference-service, and retention TTL for traces. Can owners call out blockers? Aiming to close by EOD Wed so PM can freeze sprint notes. Link: https://go/internal/obs-roadmap (internal)

Ben: I can own the dashboard error-rate view. Need Claire to add the derived metric (http_requests.error_rate_derived). I pinged infra-telemetry. ETA Thu morning unless Claire is blocked.

Alice: For the trace hook: found a header propagation race with inference-service that drops x-request-id intermittently. I'll push a small fix today and open a PR. Test plan = e2e + canary. Assigning @Dinesh for review.

Dinesh: @Alice ping — will review after stand. Quick question: do we want to keep KV-cached traces longer for hot routes? That affects TTL and storage calculations.

Eva: Legal prefers 90d for user-facing traces, infra cost team prefers 30d. Proposal: 30d full retention + 90d sampled retention for compliance. Suggested config:

```yaml
traces:
  default_ttl_days: 30
  sampled_ttl_days: 90
  sample_rate: 0.05
```

Carmen: That config seems reasonable as a compromise. Ben, can you add a dashboard tile showing sampled vs full retention storage estimate and projected monthly cost delta?

Ben: Yep — will add the tile. Also adding an alert if storage growth projection > 15% week-over-week :rotating_light:.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: inference-service-trace-hook v2.1.3 -> canary 5% at 2024-11-07T14:00Z

Alice: Thanks. Small follow-up: who owns the rollout/rollback playbook for the trace hook? Suggestation: eng-oncall + eng-runtime.

Dinesh: I can draft rollback steps and a quick mitigation checklist, will push to the runbook repo (https://github.com/redwood/runbooks) by EOD.

Carmen: Summary / next steps:
- Owners: dashboard = Ben; trace-hook = Alice + Dinesh; retention config = Eva.
- Blockers: Claire metric dependency, header race PR review, legal confirmation on sampling wording.
- Deliverables: Alice PR, Ben dashboard tile, Dinesh runbook update, Eva legal follow-up.
ETA: EOD Wed. :thumbsup:

Alice: ACK — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234

Ben: Dashboard tile draft added, requesting Carmen review.

Eva: Emailed legal; awaiting reply (cc: compliance).

Carmen: Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc after PRs land and ping again if anything slips.
